description: This file defines the MetaDataImplementationInterface, which specifies methods for managing metadata such as view definitions, field definitions, language settings, deployment configurations, and history data within the SuiteCRM system.

classes.name: MetaDataImplementationInterface
classes.description: An interface that declares methods related to handling metadata components in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getViewdefs
methods.description: Retrieves view definitions related to the metadata.

methods.name: getFielddefs
methods.description: Retrieves field definitions within the metadata context.

methods.name: deploy
methods.description: Deploys layout definitions or other metadata changes.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Retrieves historical data or versioning information related to metadata.
